description: This file defines the MemoryPoolSlab class used for managing memory slabs within a byte buffer memory pool in the Orleans networking shared module. It handles pinning arrays in memory, provides properties to check slab activity status, and manages cleanup via IDisposable.

classes.name: MemoryPoolSlab
classes.description: A class representing a memory slab which manages a pinned byte array used for high-performance networking buffer management.

methods.name: MemoryPoolSlab
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the slab with a byte array and pins it in memory.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new MemoryPoolSlab of a specified length.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Method to properly dispose of the slab, unpinning the memory and releasing resources.

methods.name: Dispose(bool disposing)
methods.description: Protected method to handle actual disposal logic, including freeing pinned handle.
